scripts.build: pnpm --workspace-root run build && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter example-ssr-host --filter example-ssr-react-router --filter example-ssr-qwik --filter example-ssr-angular --filter example-ssr-solid --workspace-concurrency=5 run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && wrangler dev --port 43500 --inspector-port 43600 -c apps/host/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/react-router/build/server/wrangler.json -c apps/qwik/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/angular/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/solid/wrangler.json
scripts.types: pnpm --filter example-ssr-host --filter example-ssr-react-router --filter example-ssr-qwik --filter example-ssr-angular --filter example-ssr-solid --workspace-concurrency=5 run types
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter example-ssr-host --filter example-ssr-react-router --filter example-ssr-qwik --filter example-ssr-angular --filter example-ssr-solid --workspace-concurrency=5 run typecheck
scripts.test:workers: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -n host,react-router,qwik,angular,solid "wrangler dev --port 44500 --inspector-port 44600 -c apps/host/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --port 44501 --inspector-port 44601 -c apps/react-router/build/server/wrangler.json" "wrangler dev --port 44502 --inspector-port 44602 -c apps/qwik/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --port 44503 --inspector-port 44603 -c apps/angular/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --port 44504 --inspector-port 44604 -c apps/solid/wrangler.json"
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run types && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:routing && pnpm run check:deploy
scripts.check:deploy: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c apps/react-router/build/server/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c apps/qwik/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c apps/angular/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c apps/solid/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c apps/host/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:apps && wrangler deploy -c apps/host/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:apps: wrangler deploy -c apps/qwik/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/angular/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/solid/wrangler.json && wrangler deploy -c apps/react-router/build/server/wrangler.json
